LINK_LOS on LNK-SUD-02-B raised by the planned works, on a different link.

truth.notes: trap=bad_change_loud_coincidence; A scheduled parameter optimisation batch pushed to the 2 sites of LNK-SUD-02-A regressed RRC success and drop rate until it was rolled back. Root cause node is the first site of the pushed group. Trap: the change record looks innocent, and a louder, unrelated planned-maintenance outage on the sibling link LNK-SUD-02-B overlaps in time and draws the attention. Settled by: (1) the regression starts at the change time, before the maintenance window opens, on exactly the pushed sites, which keep 100 % availability while the sites of LNK-SUD-02-B are down; (2) it carries on after the window closes and ends at the rollback.
